prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Continue to Command Practice", "Master Desktop Pet Commands", "Try speaking to or triggering your desktop pet controls right now.", "Complete Onboarding", "Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon or hide your pet.", "Test Pet Call Command"]
1: ["Compiling Desktop Pet 3D Assets", "Our engine is finalizing high-definition desktop shaders and animations.", "Building desktop behavioral models..."]
2: ["Calibrate Personality", "Tune Your Pet's Personality", "Select how energetic, curious, or quiet your companion should be on your desktop.", "Finalize Certificate", "Energetic & Playful | Calm & Focused"]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Companion Files", "Your pet files are being indexed for seamless desktop floating.", "Shaders loaded; Rigging complete; Sound effects synched"]
4: ["View Control Shortcuts", "System Tray & Hotkey Guide", "Find your pet icon in the Windows/Mac tray bar anytime to toggle controls.", "Launch App Now", "Tray Icon Active", "Right click the tray icon for quick actions and settings."]
5: ["Signing into your existing account will automatically reload your saved pets and progress.", "Pet Progress Protected"]
6: ["Use well-lit, clear photos without background blur for the most accurate custom pet render.", "Tip: Clear front-facing photos yield 99% higher quality custom pets."]
7: ["Select Your Desktop Experience", "Compare features between Story Companion Mode and Free Play Companion Mode.", "Story Mode: Interactive Quests | Companion Mode: Floating Desktop Pet"]
8: ["Enter Practice Sandbox", "Pet Interaction Sandbox", "Practice clicking, dragging, and calling your pet before placing it on your actual desktop.", "Finish Onboarding", "Interactive Pet Simulator Active", "Feed Pet"]
